# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sagargupta16/orrery/main/skills/orrery/references/diagram.schema.json # Figure money-manager-import (2026-10-22). Evidence paths are relative to the repo root. # Left out on purpose: # - the 401 for an invalid, expired or revoked upload token (api/deps.py:110-116) # - rate limits on the route (api/money_manager_upload.py:42-43) # - Cancel on the review card and the force re-import of an up-to-date backup (useMoneyManagerImport.ts:151-163) # - the browser's own 4.5 MB body check before posting (services/api/moneyManagerBackup.ts:64-66) # - the 500 for OSError, RuntimeError and SQLAlchemyError (api/money_manager_upload.py:81-85) # - a failed analytics refresh: the ledger stays saved and analytics_status is failed (services/money_manager_import.py:80-85) # - normalization, transfer pairing and soft deletes inside the snapshot path (statement-import.yaml draws them) title: Money Manager backup import subtitle: The server reads the .mmbak itself; a dry run fills the review, and only a confirmed or token upload commits kind: flowchart direction: down
layout: { spacing: compact } groups: lane-iphone: type: lane label: iPhone (outside the repo) evidence: docs/HANDBOOK.md:159-189 lane-browser: type: lane label: Browser (Upload page) evidence: frontend/src/pages/upload-sync/useMoneyManagerImport.ts:49-59#useMoneyManagerImport lane-api: type: lane label: Backend (FastAPI) evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/api/money_manager_upload.py:31-52#upload_money_manager_backup
nodes: mm-backup: shape: document label: Money Manager backup note: .mmbak in iCloud Drive in: lane-iphone evidence: docs/HANDBOOK.md:161-162 shortcut: shape: data label: iOS Shortcut note: "gzip, POST, upload token" in: lane-iphone # Make Archive gzip (HANDBOOK.md:174), POST with Authorization: Bearer <token> (HANDBOOK.md:175-177) evidence: docs/HANDBOOK.md:169-177 choose: shape: terminator label: Choose a .mmbak in: lane-browser # .mmbak goes to the backup flow, not the spreadsheet parser evidence: - frontend/src/pages/upload-sync/useUploadSync.ts:141-147#isMoneyManagerBackup - frontend/src/pages/upload-sync/moneyManagerUtils.ts:15-16#isMoneyManagerBackup gzip: shape: process label: Gzip in the browser note: CompressionStream in: lane-browser evidence: frontend/src/services/api/moneyManagerBackup.ts:49-54#gzipBackup dry-post: shape: data label: POST dry_run=true in: lane-browser evidence: - frontend/src/pages/upload-sync/useMoneyManagerImport.ts:121-127#mutateAsync - frontend/src/services/api/moneyManagerBackup.ts:67-73 review: shape: manual label: Review card note: "added, updated, removed" in: lane-browser evidence: - frontend/src/pages/upload-sync/components/MoneyManagerReview.tsx:18-37#MoneyManagerReview - frontend/src/pages/upload-sync/useMoneyManagerImport.ts:75-78#setReview confirm-post: shape: data label: POST import note: allow_large_delete=true in: lane-browser # confirm reposts the same gzip bytes with dryRun false (useMoneyManagerImport.ts:144-156) evidence: - frontend/src/pages/upload-sync/useMoneyManagerImport.ts:144-156#confirm - frontend/src/hooks/api/useMoneyManagerUpload.ts:16-19#mutationFn size: shape: decision label: Body within limit? in: lane-api evidence: - backend/src/ledger_sync/api/main.py:78#_BOUNDED_UPLOAD_PATHS - backend/src/ledger_sync/api/main.py:81#UploadSizeLimitMiddleware principal: shape: process label: Identify uploader note: JWT, or lsu_ token in: lane-api # a token forces dry_run and allow_large_delete off (money_manager_upload.py:62-67) evidence: - backend/src/ledger_sync/api/deps.py:102-121#get_upload_principal - backend/src/ledger_sync/services/upload_tokens.py:88#authenticate_upload_token - backend/src/ledger_sync/api/money_manager_upload.py:62-67#token_id rej-size: shape: terminator label: "413, ledger unchanged" in: lane-api evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/api/main.py:114-120 read: shape: predefined label: Read backup note: gzip or zip, SQLite checks in: lane-api # gzip or zip (unpack_backup), in-memory defensive query-only SQLite with quick_check (_connect), tables (_check_schema), rows with UIDs (_read_rows) evidence: - backend/src/ledger_sync/ingest/money_manager.py:115-135#read_backup - backend/src/ledger_sync/ingest/money_manager.py:138#unpack_backup - backend/src/ledger_sync/ingest/money_manager.py:197-214#_connect - backend/src/ledger_sync/ingest/money_manager.py:223#_check_schema - backend/src/ledger_sync/ingest/money_manager.py:241#_read_rows dup: shape: decision label: Already imported? note: SQLite store hash in: lane-api evidence: - backend/src/ledger_sync/services/money_manager_import.py:60-61#check_already_imported - backend/src/ledger_sync/core/sync_engine.py:96#check_already_imported rej-read: shape: terminator label: "400, ledger unchanged" in: lane-api evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/api/money_manager_upload.py:72-77#MoneyManagerBackupError reconcile: shape: process label: Reconcile, source UID first in: lane-api evidence: - backend/src/ledger_sync/core/source_identity.py:43#match_source_uids - backend/src/ledger_sync/core/source_identity.py:89#adopt_edited_source_rows - backend/src/ledger_sync/core/import_identity.py:171-205#load_identity_matches - backend/src/ledger_sync/core/reconciler.py:114#load_identity_matches unchanged: shape: terminator label: 200 unchanged in: lane-api evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/services/money_manager_import.py:61#unchanged large: shape: decision label: "Removes > max(25, 5%)?" note: guarded unless confirmed in: lane-api evidence: - backend/src/ledger_sync/core/sync_engine.py:67-68#_deletion_allowance - backend/src/ledger_sync/core/sync_engine.py:190-191#LargeDeletionError - backend/src/ledger_sync/services/money_manager_import.py:64#guard_deletions dry: shape: decision label: Dry run? note: preview rolls back in: lane-api evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/core/sync_engine.py:192-194#dry_run rej-large: shape: terminator label: "409, rolled back" in: lane-api evidence: - backend/src/ledger_sync/core/sync_engine.py:206-208#rollback - backend/src/ledger_sync/api/money_manager_upload.py:78-80#LargeDeletionError commit: shape: database label: Commit ledger + import log note: "+ account settings, one unit" in: lane-api evidence: - backend/src/ledger_sync/core/sync_engine.py:195-205#commit - backend/src/ledger_sync/services/money_manager_import.py:65#apply_account_settings - backend/src/ledger_sync/services/money_manager_import.py:89#apply_account_settings refresh: shape: predefined label: Refresh analytics note: a failure keeps the ledger in: lane-api evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/services/money_manager_import.py:77-85#refresh_analytics imported: shape: terminator label: 200 imported in: lane-api evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/services/money_manager_import.py:86#imported
edges: - from: mm-backup to: shortcut label: on app close evidence: docs/HANDBOOK.md:181 - from: shortcut to: size evidence: docs/HANDBOOK.md:175-177 - from: choose to: gzip evidence: frontend/src/pages/upload-sync/useMoneyManagerImport.ts:150#gzipBackup - from: gzip to: dry-post evidence: frontend/src/pages/upload-sync/useMoneyManagerImport.ts:118-127#readBackup - from: dry-post to: size evidence: frontend/src/services/api/moneyManagerBackup.ts:67#money-manager - from: review to: confirm-post label: confirm evidence: frontend/src/pages/upload-sync/components/MoneyManagerReview.tsx:122-123#onConfirm - from: confirm-post to: size evidence: frontend/src/services/api/moneyManagerBackup.ts:67#money-manager - from: size to: rej-size label: "no" evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/api/main.py:114-120 - from: size to: principal label: "yes" evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/api/money_manager_upload.py:44-47#principal - from: principal to: read evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/services/money_manager_import.py:57#read_backup - from: read to: rej-read label: unreadable evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/api/money_manager_upload.py:72-74#MoneyManagerBackupError - from: read to: dup evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/services/money_manager_import.py:57-60 - from: dup to: unchanged label: "yes, not forced" evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/services/money_manager_import.py:60-61#force - from: dup to: reconcile label: "no" evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/services/money_manager_import.py:69-71#import_rows - from: reconcile to: large evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/core/sync_engine.py:174-191 - from: large to: rej-large label: "yes" evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/core/sync_engine.py:190-191#LargeDeletionError - from: large to: dry label: "no" evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/core/sync_engine.py:192 - from: dry to: review label: "yes: 200 preview" evidence: - backend/src/ledger_sync/core/sync_engine.py:192-194#rollback - backend/src/ledger_sync/services/money_manager_import.py:75-76#preview - frontend/src/pages/upload-sync/useMoneyManagerImport.ts:75-78#preview - from: dry to: commit label: "no" evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/core/sync_engine.py:195-205 - from: commit to: refresh evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/services/money_manager_import.py:77-79#refresh_analytics - (no); Dry run? to Review card (yes: 200 preview); Dry run? to Commit ledger + import log (no); Commit ledger + import log to Refresh analytics; Refresh analytics to 200 imported.
